+6​pmax​(MC​(C−1M−1)+MC​(M−CM−1))​((LF​cy)2​‖𝒚r−𝒚∗​(𝒙r)‖2+(L~F​cx)2​‖𝒙r−𝒙∗‖2+𝒱F),\displaystyle\quad+6p_{\text{max}}\left(\frac{M}{C}\left(\frac{C-1}{M-1}\right)+\frac{M}{C}\left(\frac{M-C}{M-1}\right)\right)\left((L_{Fc}^{y})^{2}\|\bm{y}_{r}-\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{r})\|^{2}+(\tilde{L}_{Fc}^{x})^{2}\|\bm{x}_{r}-\bm{x}^{*}\|^{2}+\mathcal{V}_{F}\right), (204)
𝔼​‖∇y,r(s)‖2\displaystyle\mathbb{E}\|\nabla_{y,r}^{(s)}\|^{2}
≤2​MC​∑i=1Mpi2​∑k=0Kr−1σg2+pmax​(4​MC​(M−CM−1)+6​MC​(C−1M−1))​∑i=1Mpi​∑k=0Kr−1Δg,i,r,k\displaystyle\leq\frac{2M}{C}\sum_{i=1}^{M}p_{i}^{2}\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\sigma_{g}^{2}+p_{\text{max}}\left(\frac{4M}{C}\left(\frac{M-C}{M-1}\right)+\frac{6M}{C}\left(\frac{C-1}{M-1}\right)\right)\sum_{i=1}^{M}p_{i}\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\Delta_{g,i,r,k}
+(4​MC​(M−CM−1)​pmax​(Lgy)2+6​MC​(C−1M−1)​(Lgy)2)​𝔼​‖𝒚r−𝒚∗​(𝒙r)‖2,\displaystyle\quad+\left(\frac{4M}{C}\left(\frac{M-C}{M-1}\right)p_{\text{max}}(L_{g}^{y})^{2}+\frac{6M}{C}\left(\frac{C-1}{M-1}\right)(L_{g}^{y})^{2}\right)\mathbb{E}\|\bm{y}_{r}-\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{r})\|^{2}, (205)

and

𝔼​‖∇v,r(s)‖2\displaystyle\mathbb{E}\|\nabla_{v,r}^{(s)}\|^{2}
≤8​MC​∑i=1Mpi2​∑k=0Kr−1(σf2+σr2+2​ι2​σg​g2)+2​MC​(C−1M−1)​𝔼​‖∑i=1Mpi​∑k=0Kr−1∇vli​(𝒙i,r,k,𝒚i,r,k,𝒗i,r,k,ψ)‖2\displaystyle\leq\frac{8M}{C}\sum_{i=1}^{M}p_{i}^{2}\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\left(\sigma_{f}^{2}+\sigma_{r}^{2}+2\iota^{2}\sigma_{gg}^{2}\right)+\frac{2M}{C}\left(\frac{C-1}{M-1}\right)\mathbb{E}\left\|\sum_{i=1}^{M}p_{i}\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\nabla_{v}l_{i}(\bm{x}_{i,r,k},\bm{y}_{i,r,k},\bm{v}_{i,r,k};\psi)\right\|^{2}
+4​MC(M−CM−1)∑i=1Mpi2∑k=0Kr−1𝔼‖∇vli(𝒙i,r,k,𝒚i,r,k,𝒗i,r,k;ψ)−∇vli(𝒙r,𝒚r,𝒗r;ψ)‖2\displaystyle\quad+\frac{4M}{C}\left(\frac{M-C}{M-1}\right)\sum_{i=1}^{M}p_{i}^{2}\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\mathbb{E}\left\|\nabla_{v}l_{i}(\bm{x}_{i,r,k},\bm{y}_{i,r,k},\bm{v}_{i,r,k};\psi)-\nabla_{v}l_{i}(\bm{x}_{r},\bm{y}_{r},\bm{v}_{r};\psi)\right\|^{2}
+12​MC​(M−CM−1)​pmax​((Llcy)2​‖𝒚r−𝒚∗​(𝒙r)‖2+(L~lcx)2​‖𝒙r−𝒙∗‖2+𝒱l).\displaystyle\quad+\frac{12M}{C}\left(\frac{M-C}{M-1}\right)p_{\text{max}}\left((L_{l_{c}}^{y})^{2}\|\bm{y}_{r}-\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{r})\|^{2}+(\tilde{L}_{l_{c}}^{x})^{2}\|\bm{x}_{r}-\bm{x}^{*}\|^{2}+\mathcal{V}_{l}\right). (206)
Proof.

Based on the definition of ∇x,r(s)\nabla_{x,r}^{(s)}, it yields that

𝔼​‖∇x,r(s)‖2\displaystyle\mathbb{E}\|\nabla_{x,r}^{(s)}\|^{2}
=𝔼​‖∑i∈Crp~i​∑k=0Kr−1∇^x​ℱi​(𝒙i,r,k,𝒚i,r,k,𝒗i,r,k,ψ)‖2\displaystyle=\mathbb{E}\left\|\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\widehat{\nabla}_{x}\mathcal{F}_{i}(\bm{x}_{i,r,k},\bm{y}_{i,r,k},\bm{v}_{i,r,k};\psi)\right\|^{2}
=𝔼​‖∑i∈Crp~i​∑k=0Kr−1∇^x​ℱi​(𝒙i,r,k,𝒚i,r,k,𝒗i,r,k,ψ)−∇xℱi​(𝒙i,r,k,𝒚i,r,k,𝒗i,r,k,ψ)+∇xℱi​(𝒙i,r,k,𝒚i,r,k,𝒗i,r,k,ψ)‖2\displaystyle=\mathbb{E}\left\|\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\widehat{\nabla}_{x}\mathcal{F}_{i}(\bm{x}_{i,r,k},\bm{y}_{i,r,k},\bm{v}_{i,r,k};\psi)-\nabla_{x}\mathcal{F}_{i}(\bm{x}_{i,r,k},\bm{y}_{i,r,k},\bm{v}_{i,r,k};\psi)+\nabla_{x}\mathcal{F}_{i}(\bm{x}_{i,r,k},\bm{y}_{i,r,k},\bm{v}_{i,r,k};\psi)\right\|^{2}
≤2​MC​∑i=1Mpi2​∑k=0Kr−1𝔼​‖∇^x​ℱi​(𝒙i,r,k,𝒚i,r,k,𝒗i,r,k,ψ)−∇xℱi​(𝒙i,r,k,𝒚i,r,k,𝒗i,r,k,ψ)‖2\displaystyle\leq\frac{2M}{C}\sum_{i=1}^{M}p_{i}^{2}\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\mathbb{E}\left\|\widehat{\nabla}_{x}\mathcal{F}_{i}(\bm{x}_{i,r,k},\bm{y}_{i,r,k},\bm{v}_{i,r,k};\psi)-\nabla_{x}\mathcal{F}_{i}(\bm{x}_{i,r,k},\bm{y}_{i,r,k},\bm{v}_{i,r,k};\psi)\right\|^{2}
+2​𝔼​‖∑i∈Crp~i​∑k=0Kr−1∇xℱi​(𝒙i,r,k,𝒚i,r,k,𝒗i,r,k,ψ)‖2\displaystyle\quad+2\mathbb{E}\left\|\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\nabla_{x}\mathcal{F}_{i}(\bm{x}_{i,r,k},\bm{y}_{i,r,k},\bm{v}_{i,r,k};\psi)\right\|^{2}
≤8​MC​∑i=1Mpi2​∑k=0Kr−1(σf2+σr2+2​ι2​σg​g2)+2​𝔼​‖∑i∈Crp~i​∑k=0Kr−1∇xℱi​(𝒙i,r,k,𝒚i,r,k,𝒗i,r,k,ψ)‖2.\displaystyle\leq\frac{8M}{C}\sum_{i=1}^{M}p_{i}^{2}\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\left(\sigma_{f}^{2}+\sigma_{r}^{2}+2\iota^{2}\sigma_{gg}^{2}\right)+2\mathbb{E}\left\|\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\nabla_{x}\mathcal{F}_{i}(\bm{x}_{i,r,k},\bm{y}_{i,r,k},\bm{v}_{i,r,k};\psi)\right\|^{2}. (207)

For the second term in Eq. (207), we know

𝔼​‖∑i∈Crp~i​∑k=0Kr−1∇xℱi​(𝒙i,r,k,𝒚i,r,k,𝒗i,r,k,ψ)‖2\displaystyle\mathbb{E}\left\|\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\nabla_{x}\mathcal{F}_{i}(\bm{x}_{i,r,k},\bm{y}_{i,r,k},\bm{v}_{i,r,k};\psi)\right\|^{2}
=(a)​(MC​(C−1M−1)+MC​(M−CM−1))​∑i=1Mpi2​𝔼​‖∑k=0Kr−1∇xℱi​(𝒙i,r,k,𝒚i,r,k,𝒗i,r,k,ψ)‖2\displaystyle\overset{(a)}{=}\left(\frac{M}{C}\left(\frac{C-1}{M-1}\right)+\frac{M}{C}\left(\frac{M-C}{M-1}\right)\right)\sum_{i=1}^{M}p_{i}^{2}\mathbb{E}\left\|\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\nabla_{x}\mathcal{F}_{i}(\bm{x}_{i,r,k},\bm{y}_{i,r,k},\bm{v}_{i,r,k};\psi)\right\|^{2}
≤(b)​2​pmax​(MC​(C−1M−1)+MC​(M−CM−1))​∑i=1Mpi​∑k=0Kr−1Δf,i,r,k\displaystyle\overset{(b)}{\leq}2p_{\text{max}}\left(\frac{M}{C}\left(\frac{C-1}{M-1}\right)+\frac{M}{C}\left(\frac{M-C}{M-1}\right)\right)\sum_{i=1}^{M}p_{i}\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\Delta_{f,i,r,k}
+6​pmax​(MC​(C−1M−1)+MC​(M−CM−1))​((LF​cy)2​‖𝒚r−𝒚∗​(𝒙r)‖2+(L~F​cx)2​‖𝒙r−𝒙∗‖2+𝒱F),\displaystyle\quad+6p_{\text{max}}\left(\frac{M}{C}\left(\frac{C-1}{M-1}\right)+\frac{M}{C}\left(\frac{M-C}{M-1}\right)\right)\left((L_{Fc}^{y})^{2}\|\bm{y}_{r}-\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{r})\|^{2}+(\tilde{L}_{Fc}^{x})^{2}\|\bm{x}_{r}-\bm{x}^{*}\|^{2}+\mathcal{V}_{F}\right), (208)

where (a)(a) holds based on Eq. (24) in the Appendix of (Yang et al., 2023), and (b)(b) is true because of Lemma 8. By combining Eq. (207) and Eq. (208), it yields that

𝔼​‖∇x,r(s)‖2\displaystyle\mathbb{E}\|\nabla_{x,r}^{(s)}\|^{2} ≤8​MC​∑i=1Mpi2​∑k=0Kr−1(σf2+σr2+2​ι2​σg​g2)\displaystyle\leq\frac{8M}{C}\sum_{i=1}^{M}p_{i}^{2}\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\left(\sigma_{f}^{2}+\sigma_{r}^{2}+2\iota^{2}\sigma_{gg}^{2}\right)
+2pmax(MC(C−1M−1)+MC(M−CM−1))∑i=1Mpi∑k=0Kr−1Δf,i,r,k\displaystyle\quad+2p_{\text{max}}\left(\frac{M}{C}\left(\frac{C-1}{M-1}\right)+\frac{M}{C}\left(\frac{M-C}{M-1}\right)\right)\sum_{i=1}^{M}p_{i}\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\Delta_{f,i,r,k}
+6​pmax​(MC​(C−1M−1)+MC​(M−CM−1))​((LF​cy)2​‖𝒚r−𝒚∗​(𝒙r)‖2+(L~F​cx)2​‖𝒙r−𝒙∗‖2+𝒱F),\displaystyle\quad+6p_{\text{max}}\left(\frac{M}{C}\left(\frac{C-1}{M-1}\right)+\frac{M}{C}\left(\frac{M-C}{M-1}\right)\right)\left((L_{Fc}^{y})^{2}\|\bm{y}_{r}-\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{r})\|^{2}+(\tilde{L}_{Fc}^{x})^{2}\|\bm{x}_{r}-\bm{x}^{*}\|^{2}+\mathcal{V}_{F}\right), (209)

Similarly, it’s easy to obtain

𝔼​‖∇y,r(s)‖2\displaystyle\mathbb{E}\|\nabla_{y,r}^{(s)}\|^{2} =𝔼​‖∑i∈Crp~i​∑k=0Kr−1∇^y​gi​(𝒙i,r,k,𝒚i,r,k,ζ)‖2\displaystyle=\mathbb{E}\left\|\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\widehat{\nabla}_{y}g_{i}(\bm{x}_{i,r,k},\bm{y}_{i,r,k};\zeta)\right\|^{2}
=𝔼​‖∑i∈Crp~i​∑k=0Kr−1∇^y​gi​(𝒙i,r,k,𝒚i,r,k,ζ)−∇ygi​(𝒙i,r,k,𝒚i,r,k,ζ)+∇ygi​(𝒙i,r,k,𝒚i,r,k,ζ)‖2\displaystyle=\mathbb{E}\left\|\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\widehat{\nabla}_{y}g_{i}(\bm{x}_{i,r,k},\bm{y}_{i,r,k};\zeta)-\nabla_{y}g_{i}(\bm{x}_{i,r,k},\bm{y}_{i,r,k};\zeta)+\nabla_{y}g_{i}(\bm{x}_{i,r,k},\bm{y}_{i,r,k};\zeta)\right\|^{2}
≤2​MC​∑i=1Mpi2​∑k=0Kr−1𝔼​‖∇^y​gi​(𝒙i,r,k,𝒚i,r,k,ζ)−∇ygi​(𝒙i,r,k,𝒚i,r,k,ζ)‖2\displaystyle\leq\frac{2M}{C}\sum_{i=1}^{M}p_{i}^{2}\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\mathbb{E}\left\|\widehat{\nabla}_{y}g_{i}(\bm{x}_{i,r,k},\bm{y}_{i,r,k};\zeta)-\nabla_{y}g_{i}(\bm{x}_{i,r,k},\bm{y}_{i,r,k};\zeta)\right\|^{2}
+2​𝔼​‖∑i∈Crp~i​∑k=0Kr−1∇ygi​(𝒙i,r,k,𝒚i,r,k,ζ)‖2\displaystyle\quad+2\mathbb{E}\left\|\sum_{i\in{C_{r}}}\tilde{p}_{i}\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\nabla_{y}g_{i}(\bm{x}_{i,r,k},\bm{y}_{i,r,k};\zeta)\right\|^{2}
≤2​MC​∑i=1Mpi2​∑k=0Kr−1σg2+2​MC​(C−1M−1)​𝔼​‖∑i=1Mpi​∑k=0Kr−1∇ygi​(𝒙i,r,k,𝒚i,r,k,ζ)‖2\displaystyle\leq\frac{2M}{C}\sum_{i=1}^{M}p_{i}^{2}\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\sigma_{g}^{2}+\frac{2M}{C}\left(\frac{C-1}{M-1}\right)\mathbb{E}\left\|\sum_{i=1}^{M}p_{i}\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\nabla_{y}g_{i}(\bm{x}_{i,r,k},\bm{y}_{i,r,k};\zeta)\right\|^{2}
+2​MC(M−CM−1)∑i=1Mpi2𝔼‖∑k=0Kr−1∇ygi(𝒙i,r,k,𝒚i,r,k;ζ)‖2\displaystyle\quad+\frac{2M}{C}\left(\frac{M-C}{M-1}\right)\sum_{i=1}^{M}p_{i}^{2}\mathbb{E}\left\|\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\nabla_{y}g_{i}(\bm{x}_{i,r,k},\bm{y}_{i,r,k};\zeta)\right\|^{2}
≤2​MC​∑i=1Mpi2​∑k=0Kr−1σg2+2​MC​(C−1M−1)​𝔼​‖∑i=1Mpi​∑k=0Kr−1∇ygi​(𝒙i,r,k,𝒚i,r,k,ζ)‖2\displaystyle\leq\frac{2M}{C}\sum_{i=1}^{M}p_{i}^{2}\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\sigma_{g}^{2}+\frac{2M}{C}\left(\frac{C-1}{M-1}\right)\mathbb{E}\left\|\sum_{i=1}^{M}p_{i}\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\nabla_{y}g_{i}(\bm{x}_{i,r,k},\bm{y}_{i,r,k};\zeta)\right\|^{2}
+4​MC(M−CM−1)∑i=1Mpi2∑k=0Kr−1𝔼‖∇ygi(𝒙i,r,k,𝒚i,r,k;ζ)−∇ygi(𝒙r,𝒚r;ζ)‖2\displaystyle\quad+\frac{4M}{C}\left(\frac{M-C}{M-1}\right)\sum_{i=1}^{M}p_{i}^{2}\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\mathbb{E}\left\|\nabla_{y}g_{i}(\bm{x}_{i,r,k},\bm{y}_{i,r,k};\zeta)-\nabla_{y}g_{i}(\bm{x}_{r},\bm{y}_{r};\zeta)\right\|^{2}

We then analyze the second term in Eq. (210):

𝔼​‖∑i=1Mpi​∑k=0Kr−1∇ygi​(𝒙i,r,k,𝒚i,r,k,ζ)‖2\displaystyle\mathbb{E}\left\|\sum_{i=1}^{M}p_{i}\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\nabla_{y}g_{i}(\bm{x}_{i,r,k},\bm{y}_{i,r,k};\zeta)\right\|^{2}
≤3​𝔼​‖∑i=1Mpi​∑k=0Kr−1∇ygi​(𝒙i,r,k,𝒚i,r,k,ζ)−∑i=1Mpi​∇ygi​(𝒙r,𝒚r)‖2\displaystyle\leq 3\mathbb{E}\left\|\sum_{i=1}^{M}p_{i}\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\nabla_{y}g_{i}(\bm{x}_{i,r,k},\bm{y}_{i,r,k};\zeta)-\sum_{i=1}^{M}p_{i}\nabla_{y}g_{i}(\bm{x}_{r},\bm{y}_{r})\right\|^{2}
+3​𝔼​‖∑i=1Mpi​∇ygi​(𝒙r,𝒚r)−∑i=1Mpi​∇ygi​(𝒙r,𝒚∗​(𝒙r))‖2+3​𝔼​‖∑i=1Mpi​∇ygi​(𝒙r,𝒚∗​(𝒙r))‖2\displaystyle\quad+3\mathbb{E}\left\|\sum_{i=1}^{M}p_{i}\nabla_{y}g_{i}(\bm{x}_{r},\bm{y}_{r})-\sum_{i=1}^{M}p_{i}\nabla_{y}g_{i}(\bm{x}_{r},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{r}))\right\|^{2}+3\mathbb{E}\left\|\sum_{i=1}^{M}p_{i}\nabla_{y}g_{i}(\bm{x}_{r},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{r}))\right\|^{2}

(211)

Combining Eq. (210) and Eq. (211), we get

𝔼​‖∇y,r(s)‖2\displaystyle\mathbb{E}\|\nabla_{y,r}^{(s)}\|^{2}
≤2​MC​∑i=1Mpi2​∑k=0Kr−1σg2+pmax​(4​MC​(M−CM−1)+6​MC​(C−1M−1))​∑i=1Mpi​∑k=0Kr−1Δg,i,r,k\displaystyle\leq\frac{2M}{C}\sum_{i=1}^{M}p_{i}^{2}\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\sigma_{g}^{2}+p_{\text{max}}\left(\frac{4M}{C}\left(\frac{M-C}{M-1}\right)+\frac{6M}{C}\left(\frac{C-1}{M-1}\right)\right)\sum_{i=1}^{M}p_{i}\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\Delta_{g,i,r,k}

For 𝔼​‖∇v,r(s)‖2\mathbb{E}\|\nabla_{v,r}^{(s)}\|^{2}, we can similarly have

=𝔼​‖∑i∈Crp~i​∑k=0Kr−1∇^x​li​(𝒙i,r,k,𝒚i,r,k,𝒗i,r,k,ψ)‖2\displaystyle=\mathbb{E}\left\|\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\widehat{\nabla}_{x}l_{i}(\bm{x}_{i,r,k},\bm{y}_{i,r,k},\bm{v}_{i,r,k};\psi)\right\|^{2}
=𝔼​‖∑i∈Crp~i​∑k=0Kr−1∇^x​li​(𝒙i,r,k,𝒚i,r,k,𝒗i,r,k,ψ)−∇xli​(𝒙i,r,k,𝒚i,r,k,𝒗i,r,k,ψ)+∇xli​(𝒙i,r,k,𝒚i,r,k,𝒗i,r,k,ψ)‖2\displaystyle=\mathbb{E}\left\|\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\sum_{k=0}^{K_{r}-1}\widehat{\nabla}_{x}l_{i}(\bm{x}_{i,r,k},\bm{y}_{i,r,k},\bm{v}_{i,r,k};\psi)-\nabla_{x}l_{i}(\bm{x}_{i,r,k},\bm{y}_{i,r,k},\bm{v}_{i,r,k};\psi)+\nabla_{x}l_{i}(\bm{x}_{i,r,k},\bm{y}_{i,r,k},\bm{v}_{i,r,k};\psi)\right\|^{2}

Proof.

From the strong convexity of gi​(𝒙,𝒚)g_{i}(\bm{x},\bm{y}), we know that

(301)

Based on the fact that

∑i∈Crp~i𝔼ζ∼Di​(𝒙s)∇gi(𝒙o,𝒚∗(𝒙o),𝒙s);ζ)=0,\displaystyle\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\underset{{\zeta\sim D_{i}(\bm{x}_{s})}}{\mathbb{E}}\nabla g_{i}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o}),\bm{x}_{s});\zeta)=0, (302)

and

∑i∈Crp~i𝔼ζ∼Di​(𝒙o)∇gi(𝒙o,𝒚∗(𝒙o);ζ)=0,\displaystyle\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\underset{{\zeta\sim D_{i}(\bm{x}_{o})}}{\mathbb{E}}\nabla g_{i}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o});\zeta)=0, (303)

it yields that

∑i∈Crp~i⟨𝔼ζ∼Di​(𝒙s)∇gi(𝒙o,𝒚∗(𝒙o))−𝔼ζ∼Di​(𝒙o)∇gi(𝒙o,𝒚∗(𝒙o)),𝒚∗(𝒙o)−𝒚∗(𝒙o,𝒙s)⟩≥γg∥𝒚∗(𝒙o)−𝒚∗(𝒙o,𝒙s)∥2.\displaystyle\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\left\langle\underset{{\zeta\sim D_{i}(\bm{x}_{s})}}{\mathbb{E}}\nabla g_{i}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o}))-\underset{{\zeta\sim D_{i}(\bm{x}_{o})}}{\mathbb{E}}\nabla g_{i}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o})),\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o})-\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{x}_{s})\right\rangle\geq\gamma_{g}\|\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o})-\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{x}_{s})\|^{2}. It’s easy to know that

≤Lgζ​εd​‖𝒙s−𝒙o‖​‖𝒚∗​(𝒙o)−𝒚∗​(𝒙o,𝒙s)‖.\displaystyle\leq L_{g}^{\zeta}\varepsilon_{d}\|\bm{x}_{s}-\bm{x}_{o}\|\|\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o})-\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{x}_{s})\|. (305)

Combining Eq. (304) and Eq. (305), we know that

‖𝒚∗​(𝒙o)−𝒚∗​(𝒙o,𝒙s)‖≤Lgζ​εdγg​‖𝒙s−𝒙o‖.\displaystyle\|\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o})-\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{x}_{s})\|\leq\frac{L_{g}^{\zeta}\varepsilon_{d}}{\gamma_{g}}\|\bm{x}_{s}-\bm{x}_{o}\|. (306)

For the UL function, we have

∑i∈Crp~i​𝔼ξ∼Ci​(𝒚∗​(𝒙s))​(fi​(𝒙o,𝒚∗​(𝒙o),ξ)−fi​(𝒙s,𝒚∗​(𝒙s),ξ))≥γf2​‖𝒙o−𝒙s‖2,\displaystyle\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\underset{{\xi\sim C_{i}(\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{s}))}}{\mathbb{E}}\left(f_{i}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o});\xi)-f_{i}(\bm{x}_{s},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{s});\xi)\right)\geq\frac{\gamma_{f}}{2}\|\bm{x}_{o}-\bm{x}_{s}\|^{2}, (307)

which is obtained by the strong convexity and optimality condition of the UL function. Based on Assumption 3, we have

‖∑i∈Crp~i​𝔼ξ∼Ci​(𝒚∗​(𝒙s))​fi​(𝒙o,𝒚∗​(𝒙o),ξ)−∑i∈Crp~i​𝔼ξ∼Ci​(𝒚∗​(𝒙o))​fi​(𝒙o,𝒚∗​(𝒙o),ξ)‖\displaystyle\left\|\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\underset{{\xi\sim C_{i}(\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{s}))}}{\mathbb{E}}f_{i}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o});\xi)-\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\underset{{\xi\sim C_{i}(\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o}))}}{\mathbb{E}}f_{i}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o});\xi)\right\|
≤Lfξ​εc​‖𝒚∗​(𝒙s)−𝒚∗​(𝒙o)‖\displaystyle\leq L_{f}^{\xi}\varepsilon_{c}\|\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{s})-\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o})\|
≤Lfξ​εc​‖𝒚∗​(𝒙s)−𝒚∗​(𝒙o,𝒙s)+𝒚∗​(𝒙o,𝒙s)−𝒚∗​(𝒙o)‖\displaystyle\leq L_{f}^{\xi}\varepsilon_{c}\|\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{s})-\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{x}_{s})+\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{x}_{s})-\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o})\|
≤(a)​Lfξ​εc​Cgx​y+Lgζ​εdγg​‖𝒙s−𝒙o‖,\displaystyle\overset{(a)}{\leq}L_{f}^{\xi}\varepsilon_{c}\frac{C_{g}^{xy}+L_{g}^{\zeta}\varepsilon_{d}}{\gamma_{g}}\|\bm{x}_{s}-\bm{x}_{o}\|, (308)

where (a)(a) holds by Eq. (306). Note that

∑i∈Crp~i​𝔼ξ∼Ci​(𝒚∗​(𝒙s))​(fi​(𝒙o,𝒚∗​(𝒙o),ξ)−fi​(𝒙o,𝒚∗​(𝒙s),ξ))\displaystyle\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\underset{{\xi\sim C_{i}(\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{s}))}}{\mathbb{E}}\left(f_{i}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o});\xi)-f_{i}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{s});\xi)\right)
≤∑i∈Crp~i​𝔼ξ∼Ci​(𝒚∗​(𝒙s))​fi​(𝒙o,𝒚∗​(𝒙o),ξ)−∑i∈Crp~i​𝔼ξ∼Ci​(𝒚∗​(𝒙o))​fi​(𝒙o,𝒚∗​(𝒙o),ξ),\displaystyle\leq\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\underset{{\xi\sim C_{i}(\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{s}))}}{\mathbb{E}}f_{i}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o});\xi)-\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\underset{{\xi\sim C_{i}(\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o}))}}{\mathbb{E}}f_{i}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o});\xi), (309)

which is based on the fact that

∑i∈Crp~i​𝔼ξ∼Ci​(𝒚∗​(𝒙o))​fi​(𝒙o,𝒚∗​(𝒙o),ξ)≤∑i∈Crp~i​𝔼ξ∼Ci​(𝒚∗​(𝒙s))​fi​(𝒙o,𝒚∗​(𝒙s),ξ).\displaystyle\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\underset{{\xi\sim C_{i}(\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o}))}}{\mathbb{E}}f_{i}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o});\xi)\leq\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\underset{{\xi\sim C_{i}(\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{s}))}}{\mathbb{E}}f_{i}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{s});\xi). Appendix J Distance between FBPO and FBPS Points under Heterogeneous Sensitivities

Proof.

We follow the same proof process as the homogeneous case, and only track the changes induced by the heterogeneous sensitivities {εi,c,εi,d}i∈Cr\{\varepsilon_{i,c},\varepsilon_{i,d}\}_{i\in C_{r}}. Define the weighted averages

ε¯c:=∑i∈Crp~i​εi,c,ε¯d:=∑i∈Crp~i​εi,d.\bar{\varepsilon}_{c}:=\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\,\varepsilon_{i,c},\qquad\bar{\varepsilon}_{d}:=\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\,\varepsilon_{i,d}. (312)

From the strong convexity of gi​(𝒙,𝒚)g_{i}(\bm{x},\bm{y}) in 𝒚\bm{y}, we have

∑i∈Crp~i​𝔼ζ∼Di​(𝒙s)​⟨∇gi​(𝒙o,𝒚∗​(𝒙o))−∇gi​(𝒙o,𝒚∗​(𝒙o,𝒙s)),𝒚∗​(𝒙o)−𝒚∗​(𝒙o,𝒙s)⟩≥γg​‖𝒚∗​(𝒙o)−𝒚∗​(𝒙o,𝒙s)‖2.\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\mathbb{E}_{\zeta\sim D_{i}(\bm{x}_{s})}\left\langle\nabla g_{i}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o}))-\nabla g_{i}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{x}_{s})),\,\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o})-\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{x}_{s})\right\rangle\geq\gamma_{g}\|\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o})-\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{x}_{s})\|^{2}. (313)

Using the two LL optimality conditions

∑i∈Crp~i𝔼ζ∼Di​(𝒙s)∇gi(𝒙o,𝒚∗(𝒙o,𝒙s);ζ)=0,\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\mathbb{E}_{\zeta\sim D_{i}(\bm{x}_{s})}\nabla g_{i}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{x}_{s});\zeta)=0, (314)

and

∑i∈Crp~i𝔼ζ∼Di​(𝒙o)∇gi(𝒙o,𝒚∗(𝒙o);ζ)=0,\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\mathbb{E}_{\zeta\sim D_{i}(\bm{x}_{o})}\nabla g_{i}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o});\zeta)=0, (315)

Eq. (313) can be rewritten as

∑i∈Crp~i⟨𝔼ζ∼Di​(𝒙s)∇gi(𝒙o,𝒚∗(𝒙o);ζ)−𝔼ζ∼Di​(𝒙o)∇gi(𝒙o,𝒚∗(𝒙o);ζ),𝒚∗(𝒙o)−𝒚∗(𝒙o,𝒙s)⟩\displaystyle\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\left\langle\mathbb{E}_{\zeta\sim D_{i}(\bm{x}_{s})}\nabla g_{i}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o});\zeta)-\mathbb{E}_{\zeta\sim D_{i}(\bm{x}_{o})}\nabla g_{i}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o});\zeta),\,\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o})-\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{x}_{s})\right\rangle
≥γg​‖𝒚∗​(𝒙o)−𝒚∗​(𝒙o,𝒙s)‖2.\displaystyle\geq\gamma_{g}\|\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o})-\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{x}_{s})\|^{2}. (316)

Under the heterogeneous LL sensitivity assumption, for each client ii,

‖𝔼ζ∼Di​(𝒙s)∇gi(𝒙o,𝒚∗(𝒙o);ζ)−𝔼ζ∼Di​(𝒙o)∇gi(𝒙o,𝒚∗(𝒙o);ζ)‖≤Lgζεi,d∥𝒙s−𝒙o∥.\left\|\mathbb{E}_{\zeta\sim D_{i}(\bm{x}_{s})}\nabla g_{i}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o});\zeta)-\mathbb{E}_{\zeta\sim D_{i}(\bm{x}_{o})}\nabla g_{i}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o});\zeta)\right\|\leq L_{g}^{\zeta}\,\varepsilon_{i,d}\,\|\bm{x}_{s}-\bm{x}_{o}\|. (317)

Therefore, by Cauchy–Schwarz inequality and (312),

∑i∈Crp~i⟨𝔼ζ∼Di​(𝒙s)∇gi(𝒙o,𝒚∗(𝒙o);ζ)−𝔼ζ∼Di​(𝒙o)∇gi(𝒙o,𝒚∗(𝒙o);ζ),𝒚∗(𝒙o)−𝒚∗(𝒙o,𝒙s)⟩\displaystyle\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\left\langle\mathbb{E}_{\zeta\sim D_{i}(\bm{x}_{s})}\nabla g_{i}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o});\zeta)-\mathbb{E}_{\zeta\sim D_{i}(\bm{x}_{o})}\nabla g_{i}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o});\zeta),\,\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o})-\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{x}_{s})\right\rangle
≤Lgζ​ε¯d​‖𝒙s−𝒙o‖​‖𝒚∗​(𝒙o)−𝒚∗​(𝒙o,𝒙s)‖.\displaystyle\leq L_{g}^{\zeta}\,\bar{\varepsilon}_{d}\,\|\bm{x}_{s}-\bm{x}_{o}\|\,\|\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o})-\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{x}_{s})\|. (318)

Combining (316) and (318) yields

‖𝒚∗​(𝒙o)−𝒚∗​(𝒙o,𝒙s)‖≤Lgζ​ε¯dγg​‖𝒙s−𝒙o‖.\|\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o})-\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{x}_{s})\|\leq\frac{L_{g}^{\zeta}\,\bar{\varepsilon}_{d}}{\gamma_{g}}\|\bm{x}_{s}-\bm{x}_{o}\|. (319)

For the UL function, strong convexity and the optimality condition imply

∑i∈Crp~i​𝔼ξ∼Ci​(𝒚∗​(𝒙s))​(fi​(𝒙o,𝒚∗​(𝒙o),ξ)−fi​(𝒙s,𝒚∗​(𝒙s),ξ))≥γf2​‖𝒙o−𝒙s‖2.\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\mathbb{E}_{\xi\sim C_{i}(\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{s}))}\left(f_{i}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o});\xi)-f_{i}(\bm{x}_{s},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{s});\xi)\right)\geq\frac{\gamma_{f}}{2}\|\bm{x}_{o}-\bm{x}_{s}\|^{2}. (320)

Under the heterogeneous UL sensitivity assumption, for each client ii,

‖𝔼ξ∼Ci​(𝒚∗​(𝒙s))​fi​(𝒙o,𝒚∗​(𝒙o),ξ)−𝔼ξ∼Ci​(𝒚∗​(𝒙o))​fi​(𝒙o,𝒚∗​(𝒙o),ξ)‖≤Lfξ​εi,c​‖𝒚∗​(𝒙s)−𝒚∗​(𝒙o)‖.\left\|\mathbb{E}_{\xi\sim C_{i}(\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{s}))}f_{i}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o});\xi)-\mathbb{E}_{\xi\sim C_{i}(\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o}))}f_{i}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o});\xi)\right\|\leq L_{f}^{\xi}\,\varepsilon_{i,c}\,\|\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{s})-\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o})\|. (321)

Summing (321) over i∈Cri\in C_{r} with weights p~i\tilde{p}_{i} and using (312) gives

‖∑i∈Crp~i​𝔼ξ∼Ci​(𝒚∗​(𝒙s))​fi​(𝒙o,𝒚∗​(𝒙o),ξ)−∑i∈Crp~i​𝔼ξ∼Ci​(𝒚∗​(𝒙o))​fi​(𝒙o,𝒚∗​(𝒙o),ξ)‖≤Lfξ​ε¯c​‖𝒚∗​(𝒙s)−𝒚∗​(𝒙o)‖.\left\|\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\mathbb{E}_{\xi\sim C_{i}(\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{s}))}f_{i}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o});\xi)-\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\mathbb{E}_{\xi\sim C_{i}(\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o}))}f_{i}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o});\xi)\right\|\leq L_{f}^{\xi}\,\bar{\varepsilon}_{c}\,\|\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{s})-\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o})\|. (322)

Moreover,

‖𝒚∗​(𝒙s)−𝒚∗​(𝒙o)‖≤‖𝒚∗​(𝒙s)−𝒚∗​(𝒙o,𝒙s)‖+‖𝒚∗​(𝒙o,𝒙s)−𝒚∗​(𝒙o)‖.\|\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{s})-\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o})\|\leq\|\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{s})-\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{x}_{s})\|+\|\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{x}_{s})-\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o})\|. (323)

Using the LL sensitivity w.r.t. 𝒙\bm{x} (as in the homogeneous proof),

‖𝒚∗​(𝒙s)−𝒚∗​(𝒙o,𝒙s)‖≤Cgx​yγg​‖𝒙s−𝒙o‖,\|\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{s})-\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{x}_{s})\|\leq\frac{C_{g}^{xy}}{\gamma_{g}}\|\bm{x}_{s}-\bm{x}_{o}\|, (324)

and applying (319) to the second term in (323), we obtain

‖𝒚∗​(𝒙s)−𝒚∗​(𝒙o)‖≤Cgx​y+Lgζ​ε¯dγg​‖𝒙s−𝒙o‖.\|\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{s})-\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o})\|\leq\frac{C_{g}^{xy}+L_{g}^{\zeta}\,\bar{\varepsilon}_{d}}{\gamma_{g}}\|\bm{x}_{s}-\bm{x}_{o}\|. (325)

Plugging (325) into (322) yields

‖∑i∈Crp~i​𝔼ξ∼Ci​(𝒚∗​(𝒙s))​fi​(𝒙o,𝒚∗​(𝒙o),ξ)−∑i∈Crp~i​𝔼ξ∼Ci​(𝒚∗​(𝒙o))​fi​(𝒙o,𝒚∗​(𝒙o),ξ)‖≤Lfξ​ε¯c​Cgx​y+Lgζ​ε¯dγg​‖𝒙s−𝒙o‖.\left\|\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\mathbb{E}_{\xi\sim C_{i}(\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{s}))}f_{i}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o});\xi)-\sum_{i\in C_{r}}\tilde{p}_{i}\mathbb{E}_{\xi\sim C_{i}(\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o}))}f_{i}(\bm{x}_{o},\bm{y}^{*}(\bm{x}_{o});\xi)\right\|\leq L_{f}^{\xi}\,\bar{\varepsilon}_{c}\,\frac{C_{g}^{xy}+L_{g}^{\zeta}\,\bar{\varepsilon}_{d}}{\gamma_{g}}\,\|\bm{x}_{s}-\bm{x}_{o}\|. (326)

Finally, using the same monotonicity argument as Eq. (309) in the homogeneous proof, and combining (320) with (326), we obtain

γf2​‖𝒙o−𝒙s‖2≤Lfξ​ε¯c​Cgx​y+Lgζ​ε¯dγg​‖𝒙s−𝒙o‖.\frac{\gamma_{f}}{2}\|\bm{x}_{o}-\bm{x}_{s}\|^{2}\leq L_{f}^{\xi}\,\bar{\varepsilon}_{c}\,\frac{C_{g}^{xy}+L_{g}^{\zeta}\,\bar{\varepsilon}_{d}}{\gamma_{g}}\,\|\bm{x}_{s}-\bm{x}_{o}\|. (327)

Cancelling ‖𝒙s−𝒙o‖\|\bm{x}_{s}-\bm{x}_{o}\| on both sides gives

‖𝒙o−𝒙s‖≤2​Lfξ​ε¯c​(Cgx​y+Lgζ​ε¯d)γf​γg.\|\bm{x}_{o}-\bm{x}_{s}\|\leq\frac{2L_{f}^{\xi}\,\bar{\varepsilon}_{c}\left(C_{g}^{xy}+L_{g}^{\zeta}\,\bar{\varepsilon}_{d}\right)}{\gamma_{f}\gamma_{g}}. (328)

This completes the proof. ∎

Appendix K Limitation and Future Work

Our analysis adopts strong convexity assumptions on the UL/LL objectives and requires sufficiently small performative sensitivities to establish the existence and uniqueness of the FBPS point and derive explicit contraction-based convergence guarantees. These assumptions are standard in the theoretical study of performative prediction and bilevel optimization, as they provide a tractable foundation for characterizing stability under decision-dependent distribution shifts. Nevertheless, they may not fully capture practical federated deep learning systems, where neural network objectives are typically nonconvex, client data are highly heterogeneous, and model deployment may induce stronger or more complex feedback effects. In such settings, our theoretical results should be interpreted as sufficient stability conditions rather than necessary guarantees. Empirically, our CNN-based simulation provides preliminary evidence that the proposed methods can remain effective beyond the convex regime, but a complete theory for nonconvex federated bilevel performative learning remains an important direction for future work.

In addition, performative prediction models can influence user behavior, data collection, and downstream system dynamics after deployment. In real-world federated systems, such feedback may introduce behavioral or system-level risks, including distributional amplification, unequal effects across clients, instability under rapid user adaptation, and potential misalignment between optimized objectives and user welfare. Therefore, practical deployment of federated bilevel performative methods should consider monitoring mechanisms, sensitivity control, fairness across clients, and safeguards against harmful feedback loops. Future work will extend the proposed framework to fully distributed bilevel performative prediction and investigate stability, robustness, and broader impact considerations in more realistic deployment environments. It is also of interest to study robustness to misspecified sensitivities and to incorporate privacy mechanisms (e.g., differential privacy) without sacrificing performative stability.
